g.text: What a region loss costs you
The same event, in a two-zone and in a three-zone cluster. Time runs downward.
Triangle: incident. Play: operator action. Check: healthy. Dash: no such step here.
every partition is down to 1 replica of 2
Disable the exporter to zone B
Snapshot and restore the secondary storage
zone B has no copy of the exported data
Affected partitions briefly pause, then resume.
only if the writer was in zone C
there is one exporter, and one database
the database already holds the exported data
Processing stays down for the first two.
Partitions whose leaders survive continue processing. Client rerouting takes additional time.
During database recovery, export backlog can throttle processing if dynamic flow control is enabled.
Exhausted broker disk capacity can stop processing.
